text: For 13 years, a mystery tapping hijacked radios worldwide.
It hopped across frequencies, drowning out broadcasts, ham radio, even aviation.
Listeners nicknamed it the Russian Woodpecker.
the Soviet Union never claimed it.
Radio hobbyists and NATO triangulated it to a spot near Chernobyl.
It was a giant Soviet radar, watching for missiles over the horizon, at over 10 megawatts.
Some radios even came with Woodpecker Blankers, just to block it.
But the giant antenna is still standing, abandoned, in the woods near Chernobyl.
